{{Quote|Nothing to make me feel this planet has any potential as a rebel base!|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="BHOM" />}}
A '''mission''' to [[Jarnollen]] took place during the [[Yavin blockade]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] were dispatched to [[Jarnollen]] to scout its potential as a new [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base. But the rebels didn't know that this world was the location of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] training center.

They learned of the Imperial presence just as an Imperial patrol came upon their landed [[Rebel scout ship|ship]], destroying it with [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenades]] and dispatching all available forces to track the Rebels down.

After have lost the contact with Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] refused to try to send reinforcement ships force the blockade and rescue the two rebel scouts. So [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] decided to go to Jarnollen with his own ship.

[[File:Jarnollen_system.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] escaping the [[Jarnollen system/Legends|Jarnollen system]].]]

Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa spent much of the night and dawn the next morning evading an Imperial [[All Terrain Advance Raider|AT-AR]], before being rescued by Han Solo and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. During the escape in the [[Jarnollen system/Legends|Jarnollen system]], the ''Millennium Falcon'' was damaged and the rebels forced to go to the nearest planet, [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
